text:
ana: heads up — new onboarding asks: customer wants audit events into Kinesis/Firehose (->S3) and also a direct Kafka topic. they also want SIEM-friendly fields for Splunk/Datadog. any blockers from our side? :wave:
ben: quick Q — do they want signed S3 objects with our KMS key or customer-managed key (CMK)?
maria: ping infra: Firehose has different backpressure/transform semantics vs our webhook/s3 exporter. we need to validate delivery ordering guarantees. :thinking:
jordan: we can support both CMK and our KMS but CMK requires role/assume permissions + customer grant. for Firehose -> S3 encryption, we can set kmsKeyArn. for Kafka we need envelope signing or header-based KMS signature?
ana: @ops-bot can you paste the current audit schema we ship for hosted customers?
ops-bot: automated: current audit schema v1.8 is: ```json
{
  "tenant_id": "string",
  "actor": { "id": "string", "type": "user|service" },
  "action": "string",
  "resource": "string",
  "timestamp": "iso8601",
  "outcome": "success|failure",
  "request_id": "string",
  "metadata": { "ip": "string", "user_agent": "string" }
}
```
ana: thanks — they need extra fields: kms_key_id, delivery_transport, and original_payload_checksum. also they want a flattened view for Splunk (no nested actor).
ben: flattening is doable on our side as a transform in Firehose using Lambda. for Kafka topic we can publish both raw and normalized events (raw -> s3, normalized -> kafka).
maria: two concerns: 1) RBAC events coverage — we currently log role changes and token grants, but not all service-account scoped cache invalidations. need a quick audit gap analysis. 2) PIIs — flattened actor may expose email; need masking option per-customer policy.
jordan: agree. propose: add schema v1.9 with fields: kms_key_id, transport_type, checksum, flattened_actor_email (optional), and a "redaction_level" enum. we should version the topic and include a header "schema_version:1.9".
leo: for SIEM mappings, Splunk prefers flat keys like actor_id, actor_type, outcome. Datadog logs ok with JSON. For SIEM correlation, include event_class and severity.
nana: customer asked about replaying events into their SIEM — we should support a replay tool (export by time range) and deliver via signed presigned S3 URLs. confirm KMS wrapping for presigned objects?
jordan: presigned URLs themselves don't encrypt; S3 objects must be encrypted. if using CMK they must have Decrypt on the CMK. For presigned delivery, we can bake in temporary credentials via STS, or create time-limited presigned GETs to encrypted objects (requires recipient to have kms:Decrypt if CMK). messy. recommend using Firehose + role-based cross-account access instead.
ben: delivery guarantees: Firehose supports buffer hints and retries. Kafka path needs idempotence and partitioning by tenant_id. recommend partition key = tenant_id, and per-tenant order retained. also add checksum in header for integrity.
maria: vuln triage note: if we add checksum and signature, ensure we don't leak KMS key IDs that could be abused. strip full key ARN from public payloads, send short id only.
leo: mapping example for SIEM (flat): ```
actor_id: 12345
actor_email: alice@example.com (masked)
action: grant_token
resource: project:foo
outcome: success
event_class: auth
severity: info
checksum: sha256:abcd...
transport: firehose
schema_version: 1.9
```
nana: next steps checklist: 1) eng-security to approve schema v1.9 changes (maria+ben) 2) eng-platform to add transform + version header (leo+jordan) 3) infra to validate CMK cross-account flow + presigned guidance (ops team) 4) product to confirm masking requirements per-customer 5) docs + onboarding template update.
ben: I'll draft an RFC for v1.9 and include sample payloads and RBAC coverage table. expect a PR by EOD tomorrow. :+1:
maria: I'll run an audit-gap script against last 30 days to enumerate missing RBAC-related events and share results.
jordan: I'll prototype the Firehose transform Lambda to flatten actor and add checksum. will post code snippet when ready.
leo: FYI — compliance asked to see a sample signed replay flow; I'll attach a short diagram in the ticket.
ops-bot: automated: created ticket INFRA-834 for CMK cross-account checklist and SEC-912 for schema v1.9 approval track.
nana: perfect. thanks everyone — cc @product for onboarding impacts.
